incident_text: Portfolio updates after bank-account syncs are delayed for many users since about 11:00.

truth.description: A rabbitmq memory alarm blocked publishers (flow control), so aa-sync could publish few portfolio updates. The broker's own logs and memory metric are deliberately missing from the data.

logs.msg: memory resource limit alarm set, blocking publishing connections
slow query logged: aa consent lookup took 1.8s

trap: the broker's logs and memory metric are missing; a producer deploy and a slow database are both plausible but unproven
